        FROM e LEFT JOIN stages s ON s.event_type=e.event_type AND (s.action=e.action OR s.action='')) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_id NOT LIKE 'anon:%' AND user_id NOT IN ('','unknown','anonymous','anonymous_user') THEN user_id END) 玩家数 FROM e WHERE event_type='survey_click' AND (''='' OR action='')
